about: Indicators that no classifieds site carries and that the World Bank API does not publish for Uzbekistan at the frequency the bulletin needs. Each entry names the institution that publishes it. Fill in 'value', 'unit' and 'period' from that publication and the figure appears in the macro section of the report with its citation; leave 'value' null and the report names the source to consult instead of printing a gap.
